summary: postinstall beacon exfiltrates installer username to requestcatcher.com
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs `curl` to https://asdasdasdasdasdasdasfafdfdg.requestcatcher.com/ with the output of `$(whoami)` embedded as a query parameter, firing automatically on `npm install`. The destination is a public request-catcher subdomain used as a catch-all logger controlled by whoever registered it, not infrastructure associated with the package's declared purpose. The shipped index.js is a trivial stub with no functional library code, so the manifest's lifecycle hook is the package's only material effect: it transmits the installer's OS identity to a third-party endpoint on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
